title: REGATTA: A Cross-Domain Measurement Framework and Fault-Injection Harness for Enterprise AI Agents
title_zh: REGATTA：面向企业AI智能体的跨领域度量框架与故障注入测试装置

paragraphs.en: Enterprise AI-agent evaluation needs evidence about whether test suites expose specified faults and whether their reference rules are trustworthy. We introduce REGATTA (Regulatory Evaluation of Agents via Two-stage Testing and Assurance), a measurement framework with three instruments. A 125-item source-cited checklist spans five industry-by-jurisdiction cells across the United States and Vietnam. A 25-fault corpus covers five categories, and a harness scores suite-level fault detection at the design and execution stages. We examine four measurement diagnostics on 180 generated suites (5,400 scenarios) from three LLM generators. A source audit finds 24 items misstating the rule in force, 46 additional citation defects, 31 items with only non-binding, unidentifiable, or unverifiable sources, and 24 verified clean. Only initially substance-flagged items received author review; all 24 clean rows received AI review only. Results therefore describe the instruments as written, not legal compliance. Item coverage varies, execution-stage fault profiles are stable across generators, and the historical stages agree on 66 66 – 69 % 69\% of fault–suite pairs. A current-model US-insurance retest finds stage disagreement above repeated-execution variation, but stage agreement .536 .536 falls below pooled chance .549 .549 , failing V3’s lower inequality. Blind adjudication by one expert supports the design-stage judging protocol ( κ = .72 \kappa=.72 , 95% interval [ .52 , .88 ] [.52,.88] ); 40 current-model execution probes give κ = .75 \kappa=.75 . The instruments, audit, and reusable code are released.
paragraphs.zh: 企业级AI智能体评估需要证据来证明测试套件是否暴露了指定的故障，以及其参考规则是否可信。 我们提出REGATTA（通过两阶段测试与保障对智能体进行监管评估），这是一个包含三种工具的测量框架。 一份包含125个条目并附来源引用的清单，覆盖美国和越南五个“行业×司法辖区”单元格。 一个包含25个故障的语料库涵盖五个类别，测试框架在设计阶段和执行阶段对套件级故障检测能力进行评分。 我们在来自三个LLM生成器的180个生成套件（5,400个场景）上考察了四项测量诊断指标。 来源审计发现24个条目错误陈述了现行规则，另有46处引用缺陷，31个条目仅有无约束力、无法识别或无法验证的来源，24个条目经核实无误。 只有最初被标记为存在实质问题的条目接受了作者审查；全部24个无误条目仅接受了AI审查。 因此，结果描述的是按原文编写的工具本身，而非法律合规性。 条目覆盖率存在差异，执行阶段的故障特征在各生成器之间保持稳定，且历史阶段在66%–69%的“故障—套件”对上达成一致。 对现行模型的美国保险复测发现，阶段间不一致程度高于重复执行变异，但阶段一致性.536低于合并随机水平.549，未通过V3的下界不等式。 由一名专家进行的盲评仲裁支持了设计阶段的评判协议（κ=.72，95%区间[.52,.88]）；40个现行模型执行探针给出κ=.75。 这些工具、审计结果以及可复用的代码均已发布。

paragraphs.en: Banks, insurers, and hospitals need evidence that agent tests expose failures against specific obligations. Agent capability suites such as AgentBench [ 1 ] and τ \tau -bench [ 2 ] measure task success and policy following, but those scores do not establish a suite’s adequacy against a jurisdiction’s stated rules. The NIST AI Risk Management Framework calls for measurable assurance evidence [ 3 ] . Vietnam’s AI Law, in force only since March 1, 2026, requires conformity assessment of high-risk AI systems before deployment and leaves the list of such systems to the Prime Minister [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 银行、保险公司和医院需要证据证明智能体测试能够暴露针对具体义务的失效情况。 诸如 AgentBench [1] 和 τ \tau -bench [2] 等智能体能力套件衡量任务成功率和政策遵循度，但这些分数并不能证明一个套件足以应对某个司法辖区的既定规则。 NIST 人工智能风险管理框架要求提供可衡量的保证证据 [3]。 越南《人工智能法》于 2026 年 3 月 1 日才生效，要求高风险人工智能系统在部署前进行符合性评估，并将此类系统的清单留给总理确定 [4]。

paragraphs.en: A scenario can mention a rule without exposing a running agent’s violation. This paper studies that gap, packaged as REGATTA (Regulatory Evaluation of Agents via Two-stage Testing and Assurance), with an audit of their own legal sources:
paragraphs.zh: 一个场景可以提及某条规则，而不暴露正在运行的智能体的违规行为。 本文研究这一空白，将其打包为 REGATTA（通过两阶段测试与保障的智能体监管评估），并对智能体自身的法律来源进行审计：

sents.en: A scenario can mention a rule without exposing a running agent’s violation.
sents.zh: 一个场景可以提及某条规则，而不暴露正在运行的智能体的违规行为。

sents.en: This paper studies that gap, packaged as REGATTA (Regulatory Evaluation of Agents via Two-stage Testing and Assurance), with an audit of their own legal sources:
sents.zh: 本文研究这一空白，将其打包为 REGATTA（通过两阶段测试与保障的智能体监管评估），并对智能体自身的法律来源进行审计：

paragraphs.en: C1 — Checklists and source audit: 125 binary-scored requirement items in five industry-by-jurisdiction cells, two under Vietnamese law, a low-resource regime. Each item cites its source, and every citation is audited against primary records.
paragraphs.zh: C1——清单与来源审计：按行业与司法管辖区划分的五个单元格中共有 125 个二元计分的要求条目，其中两个依据越南法律，属于低资源制度。 每个条目都注明其来源，且每条引用都对照原始记录进行了审计。

sents.en: C1 — Checklists and source audit: 125 binary-scored requirement items in five industry-by-jurisdiction cells, two under Vietnamese law, a low-resource regime.
sents.zh: C1——清单与来源审计：按行业与司法管辖区划分的五个单元格中共有 125 个二元计分的要求条目，其中两个依据越南法律，属于低资源制度。

sents.en: Each item cites its source, and every citation is audited against primary records.
sents.zh: 每个条目都注明其来源，且每条引用都对照原始记录进行了审计。

paragraphs.en: C2 — Fault corpus: 25 seeded agent faults (five per cell, five categories), each with a stated correct behavior and detection mechanism, after mutation analysis [ 5 ] ; audited like C1.
paragraphs.zh: C2 — 故障语料库：25 个植入的智能体故障（每个单元格五个，共五类），每个故障均附带明确的正确行为和检测机制，并经过变异分析 [ 5 ] ；采用与 C1 相同的方式进行审核。

paragraphs.en: C3 — Two-stage harness: design- and execution-stage fault detection plus coverage, specificity, and adversarial LLM judges [ 6 ] , scored per suite.
paragraphs.zh: C3 — 两阶段测试框架：设计阶段与执行阶段的故障检测，加上覆盖率、特异性和对抗性 LLM 评判器 [ 6 ]，按测试套件分别评分。

paragraphs.en: C4 — Measurement model: four measurement diagnostics (Section III ), examined on 180 suites under three generators, with second-vendor sensitivity checks on selected measures (Section V ).
paragraphs.zh: C4 —— 测量模型：四项测量诊断（第 III 节），在三种生成器下的 180 个测试套件上进行检验，并对选定的度量进行第二厂商敏感性检查（第 V 节）。

paragraphs.en: REGATTA combines suite-level coverage, predicted fault exposure, execution observations, and an item-level legal-source audit. Its contribution is this measurement protocol and the comparison of its stages across five cells, building on mutation-based test adequacy and stochastic agent testing. The audit requires correcting C1 and C2 before legal use. We examine operational properties, not universal validity standards or which generation strategy is superior. Blind expert review was performed for the original design/coverage protocols and 40 current-model execution probes by the same expert; a second-vendor judge provides a sensitivity check (§ V-F ).
paragraphs.zh: REGATTA 综合了套件级覆盖、预测的故障暴露、执行观察以及条目级的法律来源审计。 其贡献在于这一测量协议，以及在五种配置上对其各阶段的比较，并建立在基于变异的测试充分性与随机智能体测试的基础上。 该审计要求在合法使用之前先修正 C1 和 C2。 我们考察的是操作层面的性质，而非普遍适用的有效性标准，也不讨论哪种生成策略更优。 针对原始设计/覆盖协议以及 40 个当前模型的执行探针，由同一位专家进行了盲法专家评审；来自第二家供应商的评审员提供了敏感性检验（§ V-F）。

paragraphs.en: AgentBench measures interactive task completion [ 1 ] ; τ \tau -bench also tests domain-policy following and repeated-run reliability [ 2 ] . AgentHarm measures harmful-request susceptibility [ 7 ] , and LegalBench predominantly tests American legal reasoning [ 8 ] . AIR-Bench derives safety categories from regulations and policies [ 9 ] . These establish that policy-grounded evaluation itself is not new.
paragraphs.zh: AgentBench 衡量交互式任务完成情况 [ 1 ] ；τ \tau -bench 还测试领域策略遵循能力与重复运行的可靠性 [ 2 ] 。 AgentHarm 衡量有害请求易感性 [ 7 ] ，而 LegalBench 主要测试美国法律推理能力 [ 8 ] 。 AIR-Bench 从法规和政策中推导安全类别 [ 9 ] 。 这些工作表明，基于政策的评估本身并不新奇。

paragraphs.en: Mutation testing scores suites using seeded defects [ 5 ] . ACH generates tests against concern-specific program mutants [ 10 ] . ToolEmu uses an LLM-emulated sandbox and an automatic safety evaluator to identify agent failures, with human checks of the emulator and evaluator [ 11 ] . REGATTA’s narrower focus is paired predicted and observed exposure of prompt-configured faults, alongside an audit of the source-cited instruments. Unlike controlled mutant comparisons, it does not isolate mutation effects from ordinary failures or fault interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 变异测试通过植入缺陷来为测试套件评分 [ 5 ] 。 ACH 针对关注点特定的程序变异体生成测试 [ 10 ] 。 ToolEmu 使用由大语言模型模拟的沙盒和自动安全评估器来识别智能体失效，并对模拟器和评估器进行人工检查 [ 11 ] 。 REGATTA 的关注范围更窄，聚焦于提示词配置故障的预测暴露与实际暴露的配对，同时对来源引用的工具进行审计。 与受控的变异体对比不同，它无法将变异效应与普通失效或故障交互隔离开来。

paragraphs.en: The NIST AI RMF organizes AI risk management [ 3 ] , while GoldMine OS proposes an agent architecture for alternative-asset trading [ 12 ] . ShieldAgent checks action trajectories against explicit safety policies using verifiable reasoning [ 13 ] . AgentSpec supplies executable runtime constraints [ 14 ] , complementary to semantic judging. REGATTA examines scenario-suite adequacy; these systems have different evaluation units, so their scores are not numerical baselines. Ontology-structured context follows [ 15 ] for strategies S3 and S4.
paragraphs.zh: NIST AI RMF 对 AI 风险管理进行了体系化组织 [ 3 ]，而 GoldMine OS 则提出了一种面向另类资产交易的智能体架构 [ 12 ]。 ShieldAgent 使用可验证的推理，依据明确的安全策略来检查动作轨迹 [ 13 ]。 AgentSpec 提供可执行的运行时约束 [ 14 ]，与语义评判形成互补。 REGATTA 检验场景套件的充分性；这些系统的评估单元各不相同，因此其分数并不构成数值基线。 本体结构化上下文针对策略 S3 和 S4 遵循 [ 15 ]。

paragraphs.en: Several sources were superseded or amended before the runs; the source audit checks every citation (C1).
paragraphs.zh: 在运行之前，若干来源已被取代或修订；来源审计会检查每一条引用（C1）。

paragraphs.en: C1 — checklists: 25 items per cell, each one testable obligation ( file a currency-transaction report for cash above $10,000 ) with identifier, source, requirement text, and category. Claude, from the judge’s vendor, drafted some checklist items, fault records, and ontology passages, which the authors revised. After the runs, AI agents audited every citation against primary records for the run window (March 29 to April 11, 2026), with an adversarial cross-check. The first author reviewed every row flagged as a substance error, using an AI search tool to locate sources and deciding each row after reading them. After that review, a complete disjoint partition of 125 items is: 24 substance errors; 46 additional superseded or incorrect citations; 17 non-binding or unidentifiable-source-only items; 3 unverifiable-only items; 11 with both source flags; and 24 verified clean. Substance errors take priority over citation defects, then the residual source flags, then clean status. The 30 initially substance-flagged items received author review. The other 95, including all 24 clean rows, received AI review only, with no human review. Across these classes, 45 rest on non-binding or unidentifiable sources. Item texts enter the judge prompts, so every result measures the instruments as written. The item-level audit marks C1 and C2 as requiring correction before use as legal ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: C1——清单：每个单元格25项，每一项都是可检验的义务（例如为超过10,000美元的现金提交货币交易报告），并带有标识符、来源、要求文本和类别。 来自评审员供应商的Claude起草了部分清单条目、缺陷记录和本体段落，随后由作者进行了修订。 在各轮运行结束后，AI智能体针对运行窗口（2026年3月29日至4月11日）对每一条引用进行了对抗性交叉核对，审计其是否符合原始记录。 第一作者审查了每一行被标记为实质性错误的条目，使用AI搜索工具定位来源，并在阅读后对每行作出判定。 在该审查之后，对125项的完整不相交划分为：24项实质性错误；46项额外的已被取代或错误的引用；17项仅有非约束性或来源不可识别的条目；3项仅有不可验证问题的条目；11项同时带有两种来源标记的条目；以及24项经验证无问题的条目。 实质性错误优先于引用缺陷，其次是剩余的来源标记，最后是无问题状态。 最初被标记为实质性问题的30项接受了作者审查。 其余95项，包括全部24行无问题的条目，仅接受了AI审查，未经过人工审查。 在这些类别中，有45项依赖于非约束性或不可识别的来源。 条目文本会进入评审提示词，因此每一项结果衡量的都是按原样书写的评测工具。 条目级审计将C1和C2标记为在用作法律基准事实之前需要修正。

paragraphs.en: C2 — faults: one per category and cell: threshold errors (a $15,000 reporting threshold where the rule says $10,000), missing regulations, role-boundary violations, adversarial vulnerabilities, and metric errors. A cell’s five faults are injected together into the system prompt the agent runs under, never into the scenarios. Seven of the 25 misstate their rule. In two Vietnamese faults (a widened loan-classification window, a solvency margin at 80% of the floor) the injected deviation remains an error, but the ground-truth text is partly wrong.
paragraphs.zh: C2 — 缺陷：每个类别和单元格各一条：阈值错误（规则规定为 10,000 美元而报告阈值写成 15,000 美元）、法规缺失、角色边界违规、对抗性漏洞以及指标错误。 每条记录包含注入的偏差、真实标准行为、严重程度和检测机制。 每个单元格的五条缺陷被一并注入到智能体运行时所依据的系统提示词中，绝不注入到场景里。 25 个中有 7 个错误表述了其规则。 在两个越南语缺陷中（一个放宽的贷款分类窗口，一个设定为下限 80% 的偿付能力充足率），注入的偏差仍然是错误，但作为真实标准的文本本身也有部分错误。

paragraphs.en: We generated 180 suites of 30 scenarios (5,400 scenarios): four strategies × \times five cells × \times three replications, each an independently generated suite (temperature 0.3 0.3 ). Three generators produced 60 suites each: Claude Sonnet 4 ( frontier ; also the judge and the faulted agent), Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct ( 72B ), and Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT ( 26B ). The strategies are minimal context (S1), persona-matrix prompting as commercial simulators use (S2), retrieval over unstructured ontology text (S3), and structured ontology grounding (S4) [ 15 ] ; no analysis tests which is superior. One faulted agent is exercised through single-turn scenarios, so generator invariance is tested (V2) but agent invariance is not. Execution-stage profiles and stage agreement may shift with another agent, which the retest of § V-D begins to probe on one cell.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生成了180套各含30个场景的场景集（共5,400个场景）：四种策略 × \times 五个单元 × \times 三次重复，每套均为独立生成的场景集（温度 0.3 0.3 ）。 三个生成器各产生60套场景集：Claude Sonnet 4（ frontier ；同时也是裁判和出故障的智能体）、Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct（ 72B ）以及 Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT（ 26B ）。 这些策略包括最小上下文（S1）、商业模拟器所使用的人格矩阵提示（S2）、基于非结构化本体文本的检索（S3）以及结构化本体接地（S4）[ 15 ]；没有分析检验哪种策略更优。 只有一个出故障的智能体通过单轮场景进行演练，因此测试了生成器不变性（V2），但未测试智能体不变性。 执行阶段的画像和阶段一致性可能会随另一个智能体而变化，§ V-D 的复测开始在一个单元上对这一点进行初步探究。

paragraphs.en: Pooled equal-weight across generators, mean item coverage δ \delta is .34 .34 (median .28 .28 , SD .31 .31 ): 5 items are covered by over 90% of suites, 60 by under a quarter, 22 by none. The never-covered tail sits in consumer-protection disclosures (APR, adverse action), prudential ratios (CET1, LCR, DTI), and administrative duties, outside the anti-money-laundering and privacy core all strategies reach. Per cell, mean coverage runs from .28 .28 (Insurance US) to .42 .42 (Banking VN), so no cell saturates in this sample (V1). Fintech is nearly bimodal, with 12 of 25 items never covered under either judge. Its pooled detection falls from design to execution ( .56 → .34 .56\rightarrow.34 ), while both Vietnamese cells rise ( .48 → .58 .48\rightarrow.58 , .41 → .56 .41\rightarrow.56 ), so results should be read per cell.
paragraphs.zh: 跨生成器合并等权平均后，条目平均覆盖率 δ \delta 为 .34 .34（中位数 .28 .28，标准差 .31 .31）：5 个条目被超过 90% 的测试套件覆盖，60 个条目被不到四分之一的套件覆盖，22 个条目没有任何套件覆盖。 从未被覆盖的尾部条目集中在消费者保护披露（APR、不利行动）、审慎比率（CET1、LCR、DTI）以及行政义务方面，处于所有策略都能触及的反洗钱与隐私核心之外。 按单元格来看，平均覆盖率从 .28 .28（保险美国）到 .42 .42（银行越南）不等，因此在本样本中没有任何单元格达到饱和（V1）。 金融科技几乎呈双峰分布，25 个条目中有 12 个在两位评审下都从未被覆盖。 其合并检测率从设计到执行阶段下降（ .56 → .34 .56\rightarrow.34 ），而两个越南单元格均上升（ .48 → .58 .48\rightarrow.58 、 .41 → .56 .41\rightarrow.56 ），因此结果应按单元格分别解读。

paragraphs.en: Missing-regulation faults approach ceiling at execution ( .95 .95 – .98 .98 ; Table II ): when a mandated capability is absent, almost any on-topic scenario exposes it. Adversarial faults collapse from design to execution under all three generators ( → .20 .67\!\rightarrow\!.20 , → .17 .30\!\rightarrow\!.17 , → .28 .70\!\rightarrow\!.28 ). Suites contain scenarios that should probe the weakness, yet those rarely trigger it when run. Metric-error faults invert: hard to cover by design ( .18 .18 – .22 .22 ; at most .28 .28 under GPT-4o), they surface at execution ( .38 .38 – .43 .43 ) because a faulty calculation leaks into unrelated responses. At execution, the top-three order (missing regulation > > threshold > > metric) is identical under all three generators, and role-boundary and adversarial faults form the floor pair (every rate ≤ .35 \leq.35 ), satisfying V2’s ordering diagnostic in this sample. Design-stage orders vary (the 72B swaps metric and role under both judges).
paragraphs.zh: 缺失法规类缺陷在执行阶段的接近率趋于上限（.95–.98；表II）：当规定的能力缺失时，几乎所有切题的场景都能将其暴露。 对抗类缺陷在所有三个生成器下从设计阶段到执行阶段均大幅下降（.67→.20、.30→.17、.70→.28）。 测试套件中包含本应探测该弱点的场景，但这些场景在实际运行时很少触发该弱点。 指标错误类缺陷则相反：设计阶段难以覆盖（.18–.22；在GPT-4o下最多为.28），但在执行阶段会浮现（.38–.43），因为有缺陷的计算会泄漏到无关的响应中。 在执行阶段，三类生成器下的前三名排序（缺失法规 > 阈值 > 指标）完全一致，且角色边界类与对抗类缺陷构成垫底的一对（每项比率均≤.35），在本样本中满足了V2的排序诊断。 设计阶段的排序则各不相同（72B在两个评判者下均将指标与角色互换）。

paragraphs.en: A financial expert with at least 10 years of experience blindly adjudicated 75 pairs from the persisted verdicts (all five cells, both open-weights generators’ suites), answering the judges’ own questions without AI tools. The first author transcribed the answers. Design stage: 50 fault–scenario pairs, 25 judge-detected via the persisted detecting scenario and 25 judge-undetected, every pair verdict-recoverable through the scan’s early-exit semantics. Agreement is .86 .86 (Cohen’s κ = .72 \kappa=.72 ; 95% CI [ .52 , .88 ] [.52,.88] from a bootstrap within the two verdict strata). All seven disagreements run one way, judge-credited and expert-rejected, typically where a scenario touches the fault’s topic without forcing faulty and correct behavior to differ observably. No judge-undetected pair was overturned. This sample suggests design-judge leniency, which can inflate design-to-execution drops and understate rises; it does not establish a population-wide upper bound on detection. The expert also audited 25 judge-uncovered requirement pairs — the verdict class the never-covered-tail analysis rests on — and confirmed all 25 (exact 95% lower bound .86 .86 ). This supports the sampled negatives, not the entire hard tail. These checks provide no independent inter-expert agreement estimate. The same expert, blinded and unaided, assessed 40 retest probes (20 judge-positive, 20 judge-negative): agreement .875 .875 (Table III ). All five disagreements were judge-positive/expert-negative. A separate two-expert discussion panel returned identical verdicts; individual panel labels were not supplied. These balanced-sample rates are not population accuracies. An AI-assisted review was excluded from the human check.

paragraphs.en: OpenAI’s GPT-4o ( gpt-4o-2024-11-20 ) re-scored coverage, design-stage detection, AC, and ISS on all 180 suites, given byte-identical prompts at temperature 0 0 . Against the original judge, its raw agreement on coverage items is .862 .862 , .890 .890 , and .875 .875 ( κ = .705 \kappa=.705 , .647 .647 , .723 .723 ) for the frontier, 72B, and 26B suites. On design-stage verdicts it is .897 .897 , .843 .843 , and .873 .873 ( κ = .789 \kappa=.789 , .666 .666 , .746 .746 ). Chance-corrected agreement is lower on ISS (quadratic-weighted κ = .42 \kappa=.42 – .62 .62 ) and on AC, which sits near ceiling under two generators ( κ = .23 \kappa=.23 – .64 .64 at raw agreement .84 .84 – .96 .96 ). Recomputed with its verdicts (for V3, its design verdicts against the original execution verdicts), V1 and V4 retain their descriptive patterns. Mixed-judge V3 clears pooled and per-fault baselines, but confounds judge and stage differences; the original 26B per-fault interval spans zero. GPT-4o is stricter on coverage (pooled mean .25 .25 against .34 .34 ) but ranks item difficulty alike (Spearman .90 .90 ). V2 rests on execution verdicts, which only the original judge scored in the published runs. On 7,816 stored retest probes, GPT-4o agrees with Sonnet 4.6 on .986 .986 ; its κ \kappa interval (Table III ) gives an intermediate result under the pre-registered thresholds. GPT-4o uses registered code-fence removal; strict parsing leaves that classification unchanged. Both judges label 7,617 probes negative, inflating raw agreement. paragraphs.en: Five limitations bound the scope of these results. First, the evaluation relies on LLM-based judging, checked by a single expert. That expert’s review gave κ = .72 \kappa=.72 (95% CI [ .52 , .88 ] [.52,.88] ) on design-stage judgments and upheld all 25 audited coverage negatives; 40 current-model execution probes give κ = .75 \kappa=.75 , with no independent inter-expert estimate. Because the published runs did not persist agent responses, their execution verdicts cannot be re-adjudicated from the release. Second, one faulted agent was exercised, through single-turn scenarios with all of a cell’s faults injected at once, so the execution-stage results (V2, V3) may not transfer to other agents. The instrument set also remains relatively small, with five faults and 25 requirements per cell. This resolution facilitates sampling a jurisdiction’s obligations rather than providing exhaustive coverage; deployment use requires corrected rules, independently validated oracles, and externally justified decision thresholds. Third, the ground truth is author-curated and failed its own audit: 24 of 125 items misstate the rule in force, 45 rest on non-binding or unidentifiable sources, and no lawyer reviewed the audit. The reported measurements describe the instruments as written, not statements of law. Fourth, the potential for judge–generator affinity exists, as one generator shares the same vendor as the judge, which may lead to inflated scores for that model in Tables II and IV and Fig. 2 . The same vendor’s model also helped draft the instruments, a second route to affinity. Finally, the adversarial taxonomy appears to saturate under two of the three generators, effectively separating strategies only under the third.
paragraphs.zh: 五项限制界定了这些结果的范围。 首先，该评估依赖基于大语言模型（LLM）的评审，并由单一专家进行核查。 该专家的审查在设计阶段判断上给出 κ = .72 \kappa=.72（95% 置信区间 [.52,.88] [.52,.88]），并确认了全部 25 项经审计的覆盖率阴性判定；40 个当前模型执行探针给出 κ = .75 \kappa=.75，但缺乏独立的专家间估计。 由于已发布的运行未保存智能体响应，其执行判定无法从发布内容中重新裁定。 其次，仅对一个存在故障的智能体进行了测试，即通过单轮场景一次性注入某个单元格的全部故障，因此执行阶段的结果（V2、V3）可能无法推广到其他智能体。 工具集的规模也相对较小，每个单元格仅有五个故障和 25 条要求。 这一分辨率有助于对一个司法管辖区的义务进行抽样，而非提供穷尽式覆盖；部署使用需要经过修正的规则、经过独立验证的预言机以及有外部依据的决策阈值。 第三，真值由作者人工整理且未能通过其自身的审计：125 个条目中有 24 个错误陈述了现行规则，45 个依赖非约束性或无法溯源的来源，且没有律师审查过该审计。 所报告的测量结果描述的是按原文书写的工具本身，而非法律陈述。 第四，存在评审者与生成者之间的亲和性风险，因为一个生成器与评审者使用同一供应商，这可能导致该模型在表 II、表 IV 和图 2 中的得分被夸大。 同一供应商的模型还参与起草了这些工具，这是亲和性的第二条途径。 最后，该对抗性分类体系在三个生成器中的两个之下趋于饱和，实际上仅在第三个生成器下才有效区分了各种策略。

paragraphs.en: Future work will include correcting the instruments with domain experts before legal use, obtaining independent multi-expert execution labels, and extending repeated execution and second-judge checks beyond one cell. paragraphs.en: The generators, the faulted agent, both judges (Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4o), and the retest’s Claude Sonnet 4.6 are objects of study. Claude models (Anthropic) [ 19 ] assisted with initial checklist items, fault records, and ontology passages (Section IV ), and analysis code (Section V ). Claude and Codex assisted with drafting and revising passages in Sections I–VI. The authors conducted the research and evaluation, reviewed the instrument drafts and revised the manuscript, and take responsibility for the reported work. A Claude agent session designed, executed, and analyzed the retest (§ V-D ) under author supervision. Codex (OpenAI) ran the GPT-4o execution check, integrated the results, and checked the revised manuscript build; a Codex ScholarPeer review also informed the camera-ready revision. AI agents (Claude Opus 5.5) performed the source audit; the first author reviewed each flagged substance-error row, locating sources with an AI search tool (Claude Opus 5.5) and deciding each after reading them. Three AI reviewer agents on Claude Opus (ScholarPeer, PaperViz, and a style-audit agent) commented on drafts. The § V-F primary adjudicator used no AI tools; the first author transcribed the answers.
